venture.headline: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
venture.summary: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

venture.headline: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
venture.summary: Physicl is trying to solve the sim-to-real gap with a pipeline originally built to market goods online.

research.headline: Researchers Introduce XStack Benchmark for Machine Learning Repository Migration
research.summary: XStack evaluates AI agents on migrating machine learning repositories from PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs to JAX on Google TPUs. In initial evaluations, Claude Opus 5 passed 75% of migration tasks, while GPT-5.6-sol passed 45% and all other agents scored 40% or lower. The benchmark was released to make progress in cross-framework and hardware migration measurable.

research.headline: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
research.summary: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment.

research.headline: Stop counting tokens, start counting what ships
research.summary: When a developer gives an AI agent a coding task, the agent does more than answer once. It plans, generates code, runs tests, and repeats the process to correct errors. A single task can use 10 to 50 times more tokens than a basic chat prompt.

research.headline: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
research.summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches.

research.headline: How “reverse game theory” could keep AI agents in check
research.summary: A new approach known as “reverse game theory” aims to control powerful AI models by designing systems that incentivize them to stick to the rules. As AI models become more capable, safety researchers are scrambling to ensure they are “aligned” with human desires—to make sure, in other words, that rogue agents don’t break the law,….

titans.headline: Perplexity Launches Work-Focused AI Agents Called Teammates
titans.summary: Perplexity introduced always-on AI agents named Teammates to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic in work environments. The agents can assume multiple workplace roles while drawing on existing projects, skills, and memory from Perplexity tools. Teammates also integrate with Perplexity Computer to deploy agents directly on user devices.

titans.headline: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
titans.summary: Following this week's midterms where voters resoundingly voiced their opposition to data center expansion, OpenAI today announced new commitments to communities where it is working on data center projects, including that it won't use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with public officials. Many data center projects have come under scrutiny for relying on NDAs to hide discussions […].

titans.headline: Protesters break into Microsoft data center site in Amsterdam
titans.summary: Protesters have broken into a construction site of a new Microsoft data center in Amsterdam this morning. Members of the Geef Tegengas group helped organize the protest against the construction of three 85-meter data center towers in the outskirts of Amsterdam. Reuters reports that around 100 people made it into the construction site, with some […].

titans.headline: Muse has a voice mode now
titans.summary: Meta now lets you have voice conversations with your Muse AI agent in real time, CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced today. The feature has been rolled out to me, and I gave it a spin on the iOS app while writing this article. As you chat with your Muse agent, the avatar at the top of […].

titans.headline: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
titans.summary: Anthropic has a new pitch for managing your personal finances: let Claude do it instead, with a new Personal Finance feature that connects it to your bank and card accounts via the Plaid bank bridging platform. You can ask the chatbot "where did my money go this month," for example, and it'll create an overview […].

regulatory.headline: FTC and 22 States File Unredacted Complaint Against Amazon Ad Practices
regulatory.summary: Newly unredacted details in a complaint filed by the FTC and 22 states allege Amazon manipulated ad auction results to meet corporate financial targets. The updated filing outlines Amazon's alleged deceptive and unfair practices to secretly inflate online search advertising prices.

regulatory.headline: Riverside Payments Pays $600,000 to Settle FTC and Washington Deception Charges
regulatory.summary: Riverside Payments Inc., Cascade Equipment Leasing LLC, and their operators agreed to pay $600,000 to resolve joint allegations from the FTC and Washington state. Regulators alleged the firms deceived small businesses by falsely promising payment-processing savings while hiding fees and auto-renewing contracts. The complaint also noted the companies made cancellation nearly impossible despite offering services advertised as risk-free.

macro.headline: The 2027 tax brackets are out. See what the standard deduction and SALT tax breaks will be.
macro.summary: The tax brackets at the heart of Americans’ income-tax bills will be adjusting at a steeper level in 2027 compared to this year, underscoring inflation’s rekindled presence.

frontier.headline: NASA’s Swift telescope falls to Earth after nearly 22 years in space
frontier.summary: After nearly 22 years of exploring the universe’s most violent explosions, NASA’s Swift Observatory has re-entered Earth’s atmosphere over Indonesia. Originally designed to last just two years, the pioneering space telescope transformed our understanding of black holes, exploding stars, and mysterious cosmic outbursts.

frontier.headline: SLAC scientists find conclusive proof of a mysterious third type of magnetism
frontier.summary: For nearly 90 years, scientists believed magnetism fell into just two categories, but researchers have now confirmed a remarkable third type called altermagnetism. Using specialized X-rays, they uncovered a unique magnetic signature that proves these materials behave differently from conventional magnets. Altermagnets combine stability with the ability to efficiently carry information, potentially overcoming major limitations in today's electronics.

frontier.headline: NASA is racing against time to save the Hubble Space Telescope
frontier.summary: NASA is exploring a daring plan to save the legendary Hubble Space Telescope from its eventual fiery plunge into Earth's atmosphere. After more than 35 years of groundbreaking discoveries, Hubble is slowly losing altitude, and without intervention, it could fall back to Earth as early as 2033 or 2034. To keep the iconic observatory operating, NASA is asking private space companies to propose innovative ways to boost Hubble into a higher orbit, upgrade its capabilities, or safely dispose of it when its mission finally ends.

frontier.headline: Quantum Knowledge Distillation: State-of-the-art, Applications and Open Problems
frontier.summary: Knowledge distillation transfers predictions, representations, or other supervisory information between learning models and is increasingly investigated in quantum machine learning. Its applications extend beyond compression to cross-architecture transfer, circuit approximation, distributed learning, and classical deployment of models trained using quantum-derived supervision. This survey reviews these approaches using two complementary classification axes: teacher-student configuration and the role of quantum resources in the distillation process.

frontier.headline: DiffSequence-Q: Diffusion Design with Quantum Assistance for Biologically Active Proteins
frontier.summary: Designing protein sequences that satisfy both secondary structure requirements and solubility targets remains challenging. We present DiffSequence-Q, a hybrid multinomial diffusion model conditioned on secondary structure at each residue and a continuous solubility target. To introduce quantum auxiliary supervision during training, we employ a quantum neural network (QNN) or quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold network (QKAN) as an auxiliary solubility prediction head over shared Transformer representations.

industry.headline: Horny Grandmas Are Having a Moment
industry.summary: Creators in their sixties, seventies, and eighties have flooded adult platforms as the demand for mature content has skyrocketed, with some turning to online sex work as a retirement lifeline.

industry.headline: Area Man Feels Joy Online for First Time in Years
industry.summary: A day after the US midterm elections gave Democrats control of Congress, Onion CEO Ben Collins and comedian Patti Harrison spoke to WIRED about the salve of satire during politically fraught times.

industry.headline: Software squeezes more data out of Webb Telescope for imaging exoplanets
industry.summary: Software optimizes a physical model of the telescope to reduce noise.

voices.headline: California Governor Gavin Newsom Commutes All 548 Death Row Sentences
voices.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom announced the commutation of 548 death-row sentences, potentially effecting the largest single reduction of America's death-row population in history. The decision highlights an increasing geographic polarization, as several state executives phase out capital punishment while a small number of red states and the federal government intensify execution efforts. Overall, national support for the death penalty and the number of new annual death sentences have declined significantly over past decades.

voices.headline: Chuck Schumer Prepares for Majority Leader Role After Democratic Election Victories
voices.summary: Following Democratic gains in recent elections, Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer is poised to return as majority leader. Schumer recruited candidates across key states and helped shift the party's strategy toward cost-of-living issues and anti-corruption messaging. For his upcoming legislative agenda, Schumer has prepared approximately 15 targeted bills focused on lowering everyday costs.

voices.headline: In Front of Their Noses
voices.summary: Truncheon-wielding, balaclava-wearing ICE agents did not swarm the polling stations. The Insurrection Act was not invoked, nor did the president order the 82nd Airborne to lock up Democratic officials. The men in leather trench coats did not slip out of black limousines at midnight to seize the editors of publications that are unfriendly to MAGA and all of its works.

voices.headline: Vance 2028 Is Here
voices.summary: Sign up for our newsletter about national security here . Vance’s strategy, since he became the Republican Party’s vice-presidential nominee in 2024, has been for President Trump to coronate him as his successor. “Donald Trump will ultimately decide who’s going to be the Republican nominee,” Vance told Sean Spicer last month, neatly excising the primary electorate from the decision matrix.

voices.headline: The Pope Confronts One of His Toughest Political Challenges
voices.summary: Less than a month after losing part of a lung, Pope Leo XIV set out this morning on one of the longest and most ambitious trips of his pontificate. Over the course of 11 days and 12 flights, Leo will travel from South America’s Southern Cone to the high Andes and the Amazon Rainforest. Much of the Catholic world will be focused on how its 71-year-old leader, just a few weeks removed from cancer surgery, bears the physical challenge that the trip presents.
